main_text.l: In primi præsentis 2 sing. ἱστῇς, τίθῃς: Doricé ἵστᾳς: Ionicé ἱστεaι, & 3 plur. ἱστέατι. Æolicé & poeticé longa manet, ὄνμαι juuor, δίζημαι quæro.
In secundo præsenti, si actívum non sit in usu, flexio est proparoxytona, ut διδώμαι, διδῷ, διδῶται. sic in tertio, διδαίμεν, διδάγο, διδαῖς.

page.notes: Greek forms are partly worn and uncertain; several accents and breathings in the paradigms are doubtful. The marginal "Cap." is treated as a catchword at the foot. The first Greek line is a fragment carried over from the previous page.
